integrity: The claimed coefficient was checked by independent exact-integer implementations and rational comparison. No third-party independent mathematical audit was conducted.
scientific_limitations: This proves a rigorous density lower bound, not the exact density; its finite cylinders are sufficient but nonexhaustive. The proof uses a squarefree-tail Euler product and an exact finite certificate. Equivalent or stronger unpublished/unindexed bounds remain possible.
title: A certified \(77\%\) lower bound for the unitary–exponential divisor-sum comparison density
